title: Multi-Signal Rollback Orchestrator for Staged Model Rollouts
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Problem: We need a reliable automated rollback mechanism for staged model rollouts (canary, A/B, shadow) that takes multiple SLO signals into account — latency percentiles, error rates, token cost, and throughput — and minimizes noisy rollbacks while protecting production SLAs. Current heuristics trigger rollbacks on single-metric thresholds which causes false positives during transient spikes and fails to account for cost/throughput trade-offs.

Goal: Implement a Multi-Signal Rollback Orchestrator (MSRO) that: (1) ingests multiple SLO signals in real time, (2) computes a combined risk score with configurable weights and hysteresis, (3) supports adaptive threshold tuning using historical baselines and offline simulations, and (4) orchestrates rollback actions (immediate rollback, traffic pause, gradual shiftback, shadow comparison) with audit logging and PagerDuty/Console alerts.

Non-Goals: This ticket does not include full UI for configuring policies in Console (follow-up PM work) and does not onboard every legacy model; we will ship with a policy API and default presets for common workloads.
acceptance_criteria: MSRO ingests latency, error rate, token cost, and throughput signals from metrics pipeline and computes a per-rollout risk score
Risk score computation is configurable via a policy object (weights, lookback, cool-down, hysteresis)
Automatic rollback actions can be triggered when risk score exceeds policy threshold and execute one of: immediate rollback, pause rollout, shift traffic to baseline, or mark canary as degraded
Rollback decisions are logged to audit trail and emit an event to control-plane + PagerDuty + Console incident link
Offline simulator can replay 30 days of historical traffic to estimate expected false-positive rate for a given policy and produce a calibration report
End-to-end tests cover staged A/B and shadow traffic flows with synthetic regressions for each SLO signal
Runbook updated with operational playbook and debugging checklist
implementation_plan: Design policy schema for multi-signal rules (weights, thresholds, aggregation window, cool-down, minimum sample size)
Build signal adapter layer to normalize metrics (p50/p95/p99 latency, 5xx rate, tokens-per-request cost, req/sec) and apply traffic-weighted aggregation
Implement risk scoring service in control-plane: configurable plugins for scoring (linear weighted sum, percentile anomaly detector, Bayesian changepoint) and an evaluation API
Add orchestration actions: rollback, pause, traffic-shift, annotate-canary, and runbook-trigger; integrate with rollout state machine
Create offline simulation harness that replays historical traces and can inject synthetic regressions to compute FP/TP rates for policies
Add observability: per-rollout risk timeline chart, top-contributing-signal breakdown, and correlation links to traces/logs
Wire alerts: Console incident creation, PagerDuty trigger, and Slack channel notification templates
Ship policy API + default policies and run integration tests on dedicated cluster before enabling for hosted customers
metrics_and_signals: Error rate: 4xx/5xx ratios and user-visible failure rate
Token cost: tokens-per-response and rolling cost rate (tokens/s and $/minute)
Sample size and cardinality checks to avoid decisions on low-traffic canaries
rollout_strategy: Phase 0: Shadow validation — run MSRO in observe-only mode for 2 weeks across selected canaries
Phase 1: Canary gating — enable automated 'pause' and notify actions, require manual approval for full rollback
Phase 2: Auto-rollback — enable immediate rollback in low-latency critical customers with stricter policies
Backoff: Implement exponential cool-down between rollback re-attempts and enforce minimum time between policy evaluations
Gradual rollback path: traffic 100% -> 50% -> 0% with health checks at each step (for A/B experiments with long tail effects)
tests_and_simulations: Unit tests for signal normalization and risk score math
Integration test: synthetic latency spike at p95 for canary; verify action and audit event
Integration test: token-cost regression during high throughput; verify cost-aware decision path
Simulation: replay 30 days of production traces with injected 2x error-rate spikes to measure FP/TP across candidate policies
Chaos test: introduce transient infra noise and verify MSRO hysteresis avoids noisy rollbacks
tradeoffs_and_decisions: Static thresholds are simple but brittle; primary approach: configurable weighted risk score with hysteresis and min-sample requirements
Will provide two canonical scoring plugins out-of-the-box: weighted linear sum (interpretable) and Bayesian changepoint detector (adaptive). Team can add ML-based detectors later
Cost sensitivity: token-cost gets a tunable weight; default policy deprioritizes cost for SLA-sensitive customers and enables cost-aware policy for low-tier customers
Signal correlation: avoid double-counting by normalizing contributions and capping per-signal influence
Complexity vs trust: default presets must be conservative to earn operator trust; advanced tuning left to SRE/PM via policy API
